scenes.text: A honey bee makes only about one twelfth of a teaspoon of honey in its whole life.
A worker bee in summer lives for only about five or six weeks.
In that time it visits thousands of flowers to collect nectar.
So every jar of honey is the life's work of hundreds of bees.
Next time you add honey to your tea, thank a few bees.
Did you know bees made so little?

title: A bee's whole life = 1/12 teaspoon of honey 🐝
caption: A single honey bee makes only about 1/12 of a teaspoon of honey in its lifetime. Every jar is the work of hundreds of bees. 🍯
